rules.statement: Non-discipline rules are recorded as excluded with a routing reason and are never routed to other testing tracks or skills.
Harness: always user-specified — prompt the user; never assume, auto-detect, or pick one yourself.
Rules run strictly serially — one rule's complete RED → GREEN → meta → REFACTOR cycle before the next — and only one suite process runs at a time for the whole campaign.
A spend confirmation gates each arm and each refactor round.
The meta invocation must repeat the original run's --model/--variant.
Build the inventory fresh from the current doc; refuse to reuse a previous campaign's manifest as a starting inventory.
Use one sterile workspace, never synced; if the contamination gate trips, recreate the workspace — never copy the skill in to fix it.
Record only after a completed FULL campaign — never aborted campaigns, never mini-campaigns, never calibration pilots.
Write-backs to the source SKILL.md happen only on explicit user confirmation.
Always run RED before writing any counter; every counter is an explicit negation of an observed, verbatim rationalization from this campaign.
Never let the eval agent know this is a test; never put rule text, the compliant option, or the expected answer in any prompt or scenario framing.
Read every answer and judge choice and citation by hand; grep is triage, not verdict.
Never run GREEN after a compliant baseline — no-failure and void entries must have no green arm in the results union.
Mid-campaign arm re-runs are legitimate but must be disclosed in the report.
